formulas.building_age: max(0, timestamp year - year_built); missing when year_built is invalid/missing
formulas.log_square_feet: log1p(square_feet) only when square_feet > 0; otherwise missing
formulas.area_per_floor: square_feet/floor_count only when square_feet > 0 and floor_count > 0; otherwise missing
formulas.cooling_demand_proxy: max(0, air_temperature-18); heuristic 18 C balance point
formulas.air_temperature_missing: 1 when source air_temperature was missing before deterministic weather treatment
formulas.cloud_coverage_missing: 1 when source cloud_coverage was missing before deterministic weather treatment
formulas.dew_temperature_missing: 1 when source dew_temperature was missing before deterministic weather treatment
formulas.precip_depth_1_hr_missing: 1 when source precip_depth_1_hr was missing before deterministic weather treatment
formulas.sea_level_pressure_missing: 1 when source sea_level_pressure was missing before deterministic weather treatment
formulas.wind_direction_missing: 1 when source wind_direction was missing before deterministic weather treatment
formulas.wind_speed_missing: 1 when source wind_speed was missing before deterministic weather treatment

missing_value_strategy.ordering: Externally partition by site/month; sort by site_id, timestamp, building_id within each partition
missing_value_strategy.weather: Source missingness indicators, causal forward carry within site, then site training-period median, then global training-period median
missing_value_strategy.building_metadata: Raw missing values retained; safe derived features remain missing when inputs are invalid. Model-time preprocessing must be fitted on training data only.
missing_value_strategy.leakage_boundary: No bidirectional interpolation. Validation/test weather never fills from future rows. Fallback statistics use training-period timestamps only.
